page.layout: One printed page of text, one column, on the right of the scan. The strip of the neighbouring page at the far left is not transcribed.

main_text.p: putando pertinaces, indignæ Philosophia mihi videri solent &c. Fateor, me, & hominem, & asperiùs sæpe verbum asperfum esse, sed cogita, mi lector, illud Ovidii:
Mihi crede, Verba movent iras non circumspecta Deorum. Cur non scripta incircumspecta hominum, qui ordinis sui oblivis-

page.notes: The left strip shows the edge of the neighbouring page (fragments such as "t:ni", "luca", "dictis"), not transcribed. No page number or running head is printed. "A 5" at the foot is the signature; "cun-" is the catchword. The verse lines are run together in one paragraph. "asperfum" is printed as shown, with long s, and may be a misprint for "aspersum" in the line "verbum aspersum"; it is copied as printed.
